description: This file defines the HistoryServerMemoryManager class, which manages in-memory store usage for the Spark History Server, including leasing and releasing memory for application logs with compression considerations.

classes.name: HistoryServerMemoryManager
classes.description: Manages in-memory store usage for Spark History Server, handling leasing and releasing memory with support for compression codecs.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the memory manager and logs current and maximum usage.

methods.name: lease
methods.description: Allocates memory for an application log, throwing an exception if insufficient memory.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases memory allocated to an application log.

methods.name: approximateMemoryUsage
methods.description: Estimates memory usage based on log size and compression codec.
